question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:
She insisted that he ___ present during the signing of the agreement.
solution:
The correct answer is '**be**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The verb "**be**" is used in this context to express a command or insistence, following the subjunctive mood. 
 
• In formal English, when a sentence uses verbs like "insist," "demand," "recommend," or "suggest," the subjunctive form is often required.
